newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent up, NYMEX heat hits five-year high.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent up, NYMEX heat hits five-year high.

text.p: SIMEX Brent futures prices were traded slightly firmer by midday on Friday, extending the bullish tone seen overnight in London and New York.
November five lots at $23.78 per barrel, up four cents from London's settlement of $23.74.
NYMEX November crude, which rose 76 cents in New York to $24.81, was bid on the after-hours ACCESS system at $24.10 after earlier being indicated at $25.08.
NYMEX heating oil, which scorched to a fresh five-year high in New York of 74.80 cents per gallon, extended the high on ACCESS.
It rose to trade at 75.05 cents earlier but by midday Asia time was bid at 74.85 cents.
Brokers said they expected SIMEX to maintain a firm tone in line with NYMEX ahead of London trading.

But they said the high prices on the energy complex could face some profit taking ahead of the weekend, although they said the downside potential was limited amid worries about low fourth quarter heating oil stocks in the U.S. and Europe.
"I don't really fancy the downside too much," one broker said.
